links.quote: The greatest disparity was observed in Whisper ( β = 11.0, 95% CI [1.0, 21.0], p = 0.031), while WhisperX showed a smaller, marginally significant difference ( β = 3.4, p = 0.07).

links.effect: Non-native speakers consistently had higher WER; effect sizes varied by model, with Whisper β = 11.0 and WhisperX β = 3.4.
links.quote: Across all three ASR systems (Whisper, WhisperX, and WhisperX-GPT) non-native speakers consistently demonstrated higher WER, with the effect size varying by model.

links.effect: GPT-4o correction attenuated the non-native penalty to 1.7 percentage points (p = 0.057); WER reductions ranged 4.52 to 6.89 (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Notably, applying GPT-4o correction to WhisperX output reduced the mean WER overall and attenuated the non-native penalty to 1.7 percentage points ( p = 0.057), effectively eliminating speaker-level variability.
